description: John (joharnessburg) hooks. SessionStart injects endurance goal + PLAN.md state into new sessions; PreCompact snapshots workspace state before context compaction; PostToolUse offloads large file-tool results to .john/trace/ and replaces them with head+tail digests. All three no-op when no .john/ directory is present in the current working directory (i.e., John isn't active for this project).
